title: groove
body:
## groove

Cut a turned recess from the current solid tip by revolving an unused owned profile. Choose angle in degrees and a Body origin axis or same-Body datumAxis input. The native Groove must remove positive material and leave one connected valid solid. It retains subtractive machining intent rather than replacing the Body with a static boolean shape.

Native binding: `PartDesign::Groove`. Output kind: `["solid"]`.

| Input port | Multiplicity | Required | Kind |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `body` | one node | yes | `body` |
| `profile` | one node | yes | `profile` |
| `base` | one node | no | `solid` |
| `axis` | one node | no | `axis` |

| Option | Meaning | Type / constraints | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `angle` | Positive sweep in degrees, at most360 and default360. A full-turn polar pattern distributes count instances around a circle; a partial pattern uses a first-to-last angular span. Revolved material must remain geometrically valid. | `{"type":"number","minimum":0,"exclusiveMinimum":true,"maximum":360}` | `360` |
| `axis` | Body origin X/Y/Z rotation axis, default Z. For revolve/groove a same-Body datumAxis input supplies an arbitrary editable axis instead; patterns currently use origin axes only. | `{"type":"enum","values":["X","Y","Z"]}` | `"Z"` |
| `reversed` | False (default) uses the native positive sweep about the selected axis; true reverses the angular direction. This differs from moving the rotation axis itself. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `false` |
